title: Add keyboard focus and dialog accessibility
description: Ensure menus, dialogs, confirmations, drawers, and action popovers support complete keyboard operation, focus entry/return, Escape, and no traps.
acceptanceCriteria: Dialogs/menus can open with keyboard, move focus predictably, close with Escape, and return focus to the trigger
Focus is visible and not obscured by sticky headers/footers
No keyboard trap exists in representative login, node, tunnel, settings, and confirmation flows
Browser tests cover keyboard-only open/operate/cancel/close and focus restoration

steps.description: Use a browser fixture to assert current focus behavior for representative dialogs/menus and record the exact failure.
Read Radix shims and custom dialogs/dropdowns/confirmations; identify missing labels, focus restoration, or keyboard handlers.
Add focus management and visible styles using existing primitives, preserving visual behavior and localization.
Run the keyboard fixture in English and Persian where possible, then typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: Use the browser runner's accessibility tree/DOM evidence; screenshots alone do not prove keyboard compliance.
